query:
-- Compter les liaisons orphelines
SELECT COUNT(*) as orphans FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE m.id IS NULL;

-- Supprimer les liaisons orphelines
DELETE gvml FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE m.id IS NULL;
